units.purpose: Runs the spec-driven workflow. The feature-pipeline skill and the /opsx commands call it.
Runs the local Apple on-device model server. The apfel-eval skill and the llm_ops/eval project call it.
units.requires: A Mac with Apple Intelligence and Homebrew

units.purpose: Installs the Python packages of llm_ops/eval in its devcontainer. They are the run packages, the test tools, and the gate tools.
check: import deepeval, openai, dotenv, httpx2, pytest, pytest_cov, mutmut, ruff
units.install: npx @devcontainers/cli up --workspace-folder llm_ops/eval && npx @devcontainers/cli exec --workspace-folder llm_ops/eval pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
units.requires: Node.js 20 or newer, and Docker with a running daemon

units.purpose: Installs the Node packages of the fde desktop app: Electron, electron-builder, vitest, esbuild, and the renderer libraries.
Installs the Python dev and gate tools of the fde backend (pytest, pytest-cov, ruff, mutmut, httpx) into fde/.venv.
units.install: python3 -m venv fde/.venv && fde/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r fde/backend/requirements-dev.txt
units.requires: Python 3.11 or newer; the check path is the macOS and Linux layout

units.purpose: Installs the run and gate tools of tools/zai_routing_audit (mcp for the wrapper, pytest, pytest-cov, ruff, mutmut) into its .venv. The zai-routing-audit skill and the repo test suite call it.
check: import mcp, pytest, pytest_cov, ruff, mutmut
units.install: python3 -m venv tools/zai_routing_audit/.venv && tools/zai_routing_audit/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r tools/zai_routing_audit/requirements-dev.txt

units.purpose: Installs the vendored crapper CRAP gate (tree-sitter, pytest, coverage) into tools/crapper/.venv. The ub-mode skill, the feature-pipeline gates, and CI call it.
units.install: python3 -m venv tools/crapper/.venv && tools/crapper/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e 'tools/crapper[dev]' coverage

units.purpose: Installs the vendored dryer duplication gate (tree-sitter, pytest, coverage) into tools/dryer/.venv. The ub-mode skill, the feature-pipeline gates, and CI call it.
units.install: python3 -m venv tools/dryer/.venv && tools/dryer/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e 'tools/dryer[dev]' coverage

units.purpose: Installs the vendored mutator mutation gate (tree-sitter, pytest, coverage) into tools/mutator/.venv. It reads function names from the sibling tools/crapper. The ub-mode skill, the feature-pipeline gates, and CI call it.
units.install: python3 -m venv tools/mutator/.venv && tools/mutator/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e 'tools/mutator[dev]' coverage

units.purpose: Wires the cc-logging hook into project settings and ships the shim. The doctor examines the shim, the settings groups, and the interpreter. The handover-telemetry skill and the feature-pipeline Step 13 rule call the reporter.
Manages the Python environments of the crm project. The crm units and the crm commands call it.
Installs the Python packages of the crm engine (FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, and the test tools) into crm/.venv with uv.
check: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'crm'); import backend.main, agent.harness, fastapi, langchain, langgraph

units.purpose: Installs the Node packages of the crm dashboard: React, Vite, Vitest, ESLint, Prettier, tsc, and Playwright.
Scans the repository for possibly exposed keys and secrets, and reports the revoke path per finding. Optional: runs only when a security scan is asked for.
units.install: echo 'sec-scan is stdlib-only; no install needed'
